release_notes: GTMC-NPI 1.0.0: first public release. Projects and waves, tasks and dependencies, interactive Gantt, milestone readiness gates G0-G5, versioned documents with SHA-256, budget requests and approvals, quality checklist, multi-level notifications, change management, optional IATF 16949 rule profile.
requirements: Windows Server 2019+ (IIS) or Linux, Microsoft SQL Server 2019+ (dedicated GTMC_NPI database), Python 3.11+
